map.端面模数 mt、齿数 z、螺旋角 β（β=0 即直齿）、法向压力角 αn=20°: Transverse module mt, tooth count z, helix angle β (0 = spur), normal pressure angle αn=20°: pitch circle d = mt×z; normal module mn = mt×cosβ; transverse pressure angle αt = atan(tanαn / cosβ); addendum circle da = d + 2×mn; dedendum circle df = d − 2.5×mn; base circle db = d×cosαt; transverse pitch pt = π×mt; axial pitch px = π×mt/tanβ (none for spur). Hob/shaping spindle speed n = 1000×Vc / (π×d) (rpm), feed rate Vf = n×f (mm/min). Validation: positive transverse module, at least 4 teeth, helix 0-45°, cutting speed and feed >0. Note: hobbing n>500 rpm or shaping n>800 rpm is flagged as a check prompt (this page's guide line, not an acceptance standard); recommended Vc comes from the material table.
